sentences.text:
Crr/3329/2012 on 14 March, 2024
14.03.2024 cm Crr 3329 of 2012 In Re : Neyaz Ahmed.

The learned Registrar Administration (L & OM) is directed to serve administrative notice upon the petitioner as well as opposite party No. 2 to 9 to ensure their personal appearance before the Court on the next date of hearing through the concerned police station.
Mr. Avishek Sinha, usually appears for the State.
He is requested to conduct the case.
Department is directed to serve copy of the revisional application upon the learned advocate for the State prior to the next date of hearing.

Let a report be called from the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Barrackpore through the learned Registrar Judicial concerning the pending status of the Jagaddal Police Station Case No.
332 of 2011 dated 28.06.2011 under Sections 498A/307/326/304B/304 of the Indian Penal Code.

sentences.text: Let the matter be fixed on 6th May, 2024.

(Ananya Bandyopadhyay, J.)
